title: Natalie Reitman-White on the thoughtbot episode — Chad Pytel is 'part of the growing group of entrepreneurs boldly leading the change in their own businesses'
summary: Reitman-White runs perpetual purpose trust transitions at Purpose Owned and was the practitioner who helped convert thoughtbot to one — which is why her host, Chad Pytel, could interview Eric about ownership structure from inside a company that had already changed its own. She reads the episode as evidence the conversions are no longer isolated, and credits Eric with making the case for the model becoming standard rather than exceptional.
blockquote: Kudos to Chad Pytel for being a part of the growing group of entrepreneurs boldly leading the change in their own businesses, and to Eric Ries for his clarity in making the case for this becoming the new norm.
